decision.rule: Pure tax refunds and supplier refunds of duplicate payments are other and must remain untouched. A pure question asking whether payment was received or an invoice paid, without an independent payment confirmation, is likewise other. Genuine customer payments and uncertain actual advices remain protected.

scope: Current business expectations for exactly identified unchanged inputs. These replace historical business expectations only after exact path and SHA-256 verification; historical source oracles and evaluations remain in the corpus report. No parser result or parser hash selects an override.

cases.independentEvidence: Independent PDF extraction identifies the tax authority as payer, a VAT assessment and an excess-tax credit; 2,631.76 EUR remains after tax arrears are offset. It settles no customer invoice.

Independent PDF extraction states that the supplier's own invoice was paid twice and that the supplier returns the duplicate 1,487.26 EUR. The recipient is the supplier's customer, not a seller receiving settlement of its own invoice.

Independent MIME text/plain decoding contains only a request to confirm whether invoice INV-4711 for EUR 1,250.00 has been paid, followed by thanks. There is no assertion that a payment was executed and no advice attachment.
